row: My name is Helen Summerfield-Brown, and I am a rescuer, advocate and full-time animal lover. This podcast is for animal people who have rescues, volunteer at rescues, who have adopted animals, cried at animal stories and fallen in love with the underdogs of the world. If you are curious about behind the scenes in dog rescue, then this is your place. Each week, I will be sharing real time stories from around the world - the messy, the beautiful, the heartbreaking and the hopeful. You will hear from rescuers, fosters, adopters, vets and advocates. I hope this Podcast inspires you, educates you and reminds you that one person can really make a difference.
